correctness.rationale: Symmetry makes the sign balanced with zero tie probability at each interior time, so the conditional mean is 1/2 + C(t)Y_t and the risk is 1/12 - C(t)^2 by the uniform occupation law. Conditional on a positive standardized bridge value z, the expected noisy sign at scale r is P(|N|<z/r) except on a Gaussian-null set, and equals 1 at r=0. This is nonincreasing in r and positive on a positive-measure tail for every finite r. Integrating it against the conditional Gaussian sign expectation gives a positive kernel for rho>0, strictly increasing on [0,1] in rho (it is zero at rho=0). In log-odds coordinates the correlation is exp(-|x-z|/2), and the time measure is an even logistic density strictly decreasing away from zero. Each centered-interval layer of the kernel gives a strictly decreasing shifted integral since w(z+v)<w(z-v) for z,v>0. Its nonzero positive mixture is also strictly decreasing. Applying the fixed scale r(1/2) to every candidate is an upper bound for C(t) because the standardized scale has a global midpoint minimum; this proves uniqueness even for atomic noise and discontinuous scales. For Gaussian noise the arcsine integrand follows from correlation attenuation. Integrating by parts with u=sqrt(s/(1-s)), then setting au=sin(theta) and taking tan(theta), gives the stated arctangent. At zero noise the two arcsine integrals give C(t)=(sqrt(t)+sqrt(1-t)-1)/2 and the risk and explained fraction follow exactly.
residual_risks: The quadrature suite was not rerun; the theorem and constants were checked analytically. The scale minimum must be global as stated; the result is not for arbitrary time-dependent or asymmetric noise.

value.rationale: This is a sharp decision result for a natural information-constrained experiment: one observed bit for a global path functional. Exact midpoint uniqueness robust to discrete, heavy-tailed or degenerate symmetric noise removes a noise-density assumption, and covers both constant absolute and constant relative amplitude. The explicit risks give a quantitative benchmark; neither numerical design tuning nor a noiseless formula alone would give this conclusion.
residual_risks: No claim for multiple observations, different bridge laws, asymmetric noise or arbitrary scale schedules; the explicit general-noise result is location, not a universal closed-form risk.
